summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $6,000C and $7,000C accumulations in SPX for 2026/2027 expirations. While SPX weeklys (SPXW) show a bearish tilt (P/C 0.45) and heavy $8,500P buying, the dominant conviction lies in multi-day persistent buying of SPX 6000C (over $6.1B) and 7000C (over $2.1B) across the last four sessions. Significant single-trade activity in SPX 8500P ($1.49B) suggests massive tail-risk hedging, but the sheer volume of multi-year call premiums indicates a structural "buy the dip" mandate. Traders should watch for volatility in SPX as the market balances extreme long-dated call accumulation against aggressive short-term put hedging.
